kyvernoPolicies.description: Only these two keys are read (templates/_helpers.tpl, templates/kyverno-policies/*.yaml). additionalProperties: false so an unrecognised key — a typo like `faliureAction`, or the removed `validationFailureAction` alias — fails the render instead of being dropped in silence and falling back to the Audit default. `failureAction`'s VALUE is still validated by the `fail` in platform-security.failureAction, which gives a friendlier message than a schema error; this only guards the KEY.

enabled.description: Renders the six Kyverno ClusterPolicies. Needs kyverno.enabled for the CRDs/engine.

failureAction.description: Audit or Enforce — validated by platform-security.failureAction, not here. null (the values.yaml default) defers to that helper's own Audit default.
